summary: Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 to Form 8-K solely to change the proxy submission deadline for its 2026 Annual General Meeting from 11:59 p.m. ET on August 21, 2026 to 11:59 p.m. ET on August 20, 2026. The amendment does not alter any other content of the original 8-K or proxy materials. This is an administrative correction to a routine shareholder meeting notice, not a special situation.
